views.definition:
SELECT b.id AS branch_id,
    b.name AS branch_name,
    b.sort_order AS branch_order,
    s.id AS subject_id,
    s.name AS subject_name,
    s.sort_order AS subject_order,
    u.id AS unit_id,
    u.name AS unit_name,
    u.sort_order AS unit_order,
    (count(t.id))::integer AS active_test_count
   FROM (((challenge_units u
     JOIN challenge_subjects s ON (((s.id = u.subject_id) AND (s.status = 'active'::text))))
     JOIN challenge_branches b ON (((b.id = s.branch_id) AND (b.status = 'active'::text))))
     JOIN challenge_tests t ON (((t.unit_id = u.id) AND (t.status = 'active'::text) AND (t.question_count > 0))))
  WHERE (u.status = 'active'::text)
  GROUP BY b.id, s.id, u.id;

SELECT us.user_id,
    u.subject_id,
    s.name AS subject_name,
    sum(us.challenges) AS challenges,
    sum(us.wins) AS wins,
    sum(us.correct) AS correct,
    sum(us.questions) AS questions,
    (sum(us.response_ms))::bigint AS response_ms,
    sum(us.responses) AS responses
   FROM ((challenge_unit_stats us
     JOIN challenge_units u ON ((u.id = us.unit_id)))
     JOIN challenge_subjects s ON ((s.id = u.subject_id)))
  GROUP BY us.user_id, u.subject_id, s.name;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_block_async_while_live()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.kind='async_attack' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM challenge_live_queue WHERE user_id=NEW.attacker_id AND status IN('waiting','matched')) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'in_live_queue'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_claim_notifications(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS SETOF challenge_notifications
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
 n challenge_notifications;
 allowed boolean;
 ids bigint[];
 completion_notification_cooldown_seconds integer;
BEGIN
 completion_notification_cooldown_seconds:=greatest(
  0,
  least(
   604800,
   coalesce(
    (SELECT value::integer
     FROM app_settings
     WHERE key='challenge_completion_notification_cooldown_seconds'),
    600
   )
  )
 );

 SELECT array_agg(x.id) INTO ids
 FROM (
  SELECT id
  FROM challenge_notifications
  WHERE claimed_at IS NULL
  ORDER BY id
  LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),100)
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 ) x;

 PERFORM user_id
 FROM challenge_profiles
 WHERE user_id IN (
  SELECT user_id
  FROM challenge_notifications
  WHERE id=ANY(ids)
 )
 ORDER BY user_id
 FOR UPDATE;

 FOR n IN
  SELECT *
  FROM challenge_notifications
  WHERE id=ANY(ids)
  ORDER BY id
 LOOP
  UPDATE challenge_notifications
  SET claimed_at=clock_timestamp()
  WHERE id=n.id;

  IF n.kind='attack_completed' THEN
   UPDATE challenge_profiles
   SET last_completion_notification_at=clock_timestamp()
   WHERE user_id=n.user_id
     AND notifications_enabled
     AND (
      last_completion_notification_at IS NULL
      OR last_completion_notification_at
         < clock_timestamp()-make_interval(secs=>completion_notification_cooldown_seconds)
     );
   allowed:=FOUND;
  ELSE
   SELECT notifications_enabled
   INTO allowed
   FROM challenge_profiles
   WHERE user_id=n.user_id;
  END IF;

  IF allowed THEN
   RETURN NEXT n;
  END IF;
 END LOOP;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_find_land(p_user bigint, p_after_trophies integer DEFAULT '-1'::integer, p_after_user bigint DEFAULT 0, p_range integer DEFAULT 500)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT to_jsonb(x) FROM (
 SELECT d.user_id,d.display_name,d.trophies FROM challenge_profiles a JOIN challenge_profiles d
 ON d.branch_id=a.branch_id AND d.trophies BETWEEN greatest(0,a.trophies-p_range) AND a.trophies+p_range
 WHERE a.user_id=p_user AND d.user_id<>p_user AND (d.trophies,d.user_id)>(p_after_trophies,p_after_user)
 ORDER BY d.trophies,d.user_id LIMIT 1) x
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_apply(p_match uuid, p_user bigint, p_subject uuid, p_unit uuid, p_total integer, p_score integer, p_correct integer, p_ms bigint, p_resp integer, p_won boolean, p_lost boolean, p_xp integer, p_trophy integer)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 UPDATE challenge_profiles SET xp=xp+p_xp,trophies=greatest(0,trophies+p_trophy),challenges=challenges+1,
  wins=wins+p_won::integer,losses=losses+p_lost::integer,correct=correct+p_correct,questions=questions+p_total,
  response_ms=response_ms+p_ms,responses=responses+p_resp,
  win_streak=CASE WHEN p_won THEN win_streak+1 WHEN p_lost THEN 0 ELSE win_streak END WHERE user_id=p_user;
 INSERT INTO challenge_towers(user_id,subject_id,xp,correct,questions) VALUES(p_user,p_subject,p_xp,p_correct,p_total)
 ON CONFLICT(user_id,subject_id) DO UPDATE SET xp=challenge_towers.xp+excluded.xp,
  correct=challenge_towers.correct+excluded.correct,questions=challenge_towers.questions+excluded.questions;
 INSERT INTO challenge_unit_stats(user_id,unit_id,challenges,wins,correct,questions,response_ms,responses)
 VALUES(p_user,p_unit,1,p_won::integer,p_correct,p_total,p_ms,p_resp)
 ON CONFLICT(user_id,unit_id) DO UPDATE SET challenges=challenge_unit_stats.challenges+1,
  wins=challenge_unit_stats.wins+excluded.wins,correct=challenge_unit_stats.correct+excluded.correct,
  questions=challenge_unit_stats.questions+excluded.questions,response_ms=challenge_unit_stats.response_ms+excluded.response_ms,
  responses=challenge_unit_stats.responses+excluded.responses;
 UPDATE challenge_match_players SET score=p_score,xp_delta=p_xp,trophies_delta=p_trophy WHERE match_id=p_match AND user_id=p_user;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_attach_message(p_match uuid, p_user bigint, p_message bigint)
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 UPDATE challenge_match_players SET message_id=p_message WHERE match_id=p_match AND user_id=p_user
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_due(p_limit integer DEFAULT 50)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM (
  (SELECT id FROM challenge_matches WHERE kind='live' AND status='created' AND countdown_until<=clock_timestamp()
    ORDER BY countdown_until LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),200))
  UNION ALL
  (SELECT id FROM challenge_matches WHERE kind='live' AND status='in_progress' AND question_deadline<=clock_timestamp()
    ORDER BY question_deadline LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),200))) d
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_expire_queue(p_limit integer DEFAULT 100)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 WITH due AS (SELECT user_id FROM challenge_live_queue WHERE status='waiting' AND expires_at<=clock_timestamp()
   ORDER BY expires_at LIMIT least(greatest(p_limit,1),500) FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED),
 gone AS (UPDATE challenge_live_queue q SET status='expired',updated_at=clock_timestamp() FROM due
   WHERE q.user_id=due.user_id RETURNING q.user_id)
 SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(user_id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM gone
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_queue_state(p_user bigint)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT coalesce((SELECT jsonb_build_object('status',q.status,'unit_id',q.unit_id,'match_id',q.match_id,
   'joined_at',q.joined_at,'expires_at',q.expires_at,'waited_seconds',
   floor(extract(epoch FROM clock_timestamp()-q.joined_at))::integer,'server_now',clock_timestamp())
  FROM challenge_live_queue q WHERE q.user_id=p_user),jsonb_build_object('status','idle','server_now',clock_timestamp()))
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_live_range(p_waited numeric, p_rules jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT least((p_rules->>'matchmaking_range')::integer,
  (p_rules->>'live_range_initial')::integer+(p_rules->>'live_range_step')::integer*
  floor(greatest(p_waited,0)/(p_rules->>'live_range_step_seconds')::numeric)::integer)
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_question_score(p_correct boolean, p_elapsed numeric, p_rules jsonb)
 RETURNS integer
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT CASE WHEN NOT p_correct OR p_elapsed<0 OR p_elapsed >= (p_rules->>'question_seconds')::numeric THEN 0
 ELSE (p_rules->>'accuracy_points')::integer + floor((p_rules->>'speed_bonus')::numeric *
 (1-p_elapsed/(p_rules->>'question_seconds')::numeric))::integer END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.challenge_touch_profile(p_user bigint, p_name text, p_branch uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v challenge_profiles;
BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM feature_flags WHERE key='challenge_system_enabled' AND enabled) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'game_disabled'; END IF;
 IF p_branch IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM challenge_playable_units WHERE branch_id=p_branch) THEN
 RAISE EXCEPTION 'no_content'; END IF;
 INSERT INTO challenge_profiles(user_id,display_name,branch_id)
 VALUES(p_user,left(coalesce(nullif(btrim(p_name),''),'طالب'),80),p_branch)
 ON CONFLICT(user_id) DO UPDATE SET display_name=excluded.display_name,last_seen=clock_timestamp(),
 branch_id=coalesce(excluded.branch_id,challenge_profiles.branch_id) RETURNING * INTO v;
 RETURN to_jsonb(v);
END $function$
